import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import time
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import math

# Disable all progress bars
os.environ["LIGHTGBM_DOWNLOAD_DATA"] = "0"
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
pd.set_option("display.width", 1000)


def load_and_clean_data(labels_path, test_path):
    print("Loading data...")
    start_time = time.time()

    # Load test data
    test_df = pd.read_csv(
        test_path,
        usecols=[
            "key",
            "pickup_datetime",
            "pickup_latitude",
            "pickup_longitude",
            "dropoff_latitude",
            "dropoff_longitude",
            "passenger_count",
        ],
        dtype={"key": "string", "passenger_count": "Int64"},
    )

    # Load training data - load more efficiently in chunks
    print("Loading labels data (55M rows)...")
    labels_df = pd.read_csv(
        labels_path,
        usecols=[
            "key",
            "pickup_datetime",
            "pickup_latitude",
            "pickup_longitude",
            "dropoff_latitude",
            "dropoff_longitude",
            "passenger_count",
            "fare_amount",
        ],
        dtype={"key": "string", "passenger_count": "Int64"},
        chunksize=100000,
    )

    all_labels = []
    n_sample = 300000
    chunk_count = 0

    for chunk in labels_df:
        all_labels.append(chunk)
        chunk_count += 1

        if (
            len(all_labels) > 0
            and len(np.concatenate([c["fare_amount"].values for c in all_labels]))
            > n_sample
        ):
            break

    labels_df = pd.concat(all_labels, ignore_index=True)

    # Identify valid NYC coordinates (typical NYC range)
    # NYC is approximately: lat 40.5-40.9, lon -74.3 to -73.7
    def is_valid_nyc_coord(df):
        return (
            (df["pickup_latitude"] >= 40.0)
            & (df["pickup_latitude"] <= 41.0)
            & (df["pickup_longitude"] >= -75.5)
            & (df["pickup_longitude"] <= -73.5)
            & (df["dropoff_latitude"] >= 40.0)
            & (df["dropoff_latitude"] <= 41.0)
            & (df["dropoff_longitude"] >= -75.5)
            & (df["dropoff_longitude"] <= -73.5)
            & df["pickup_latitude"].notna()
            & df["dropoff_latitude"].notna()
        )

    valid_mask = is_valid_nyc_coord(labels_df)
    labels_df = labels_df[valid_mask].reset_index(drop=True)

    print(f"Training data loaded: {len(labels_df)} rows, Filtered invalid coords.")
    print(f"Test data loaded: {len(test_df)} rows.")

    return labels_df, test_df


def engineer_features(df):
    # Parse datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"], errors="coerce")

    # Extract time features
    df["pickup_hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["pickup_day"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["pickup_month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["pickup_year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year

    # Encode passenger_count as categorical with common values
    df["passenger_cat"] = df["passenger_count"].astype("category").cat.codes

    # Vectorized Haversine for speed
    R = 6371.0
    lat1 = np.radians(df["pickup_latitude"].values)
    lon1 = np.radians(df["pickup_longitude"].values)
    lat2 = np.radians(df["dropoff_latitude"].values)
    lon2 = np.radians(df["dropoff_longitude"].values)

    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1

    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))
    distance = R * c

    df["distance"] = distance
    df["distance"] = df["distance"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf, np.nan], 0)

    # Additional distance features
    df["distance_squared"] = df["distance"] ** 2
    df["distance_cbrt"] = np.cbrt(df["distance"])

    # Isolated time of day features
    df["is_night"] = ((df["pickup_hour"] >= 23) | (df["pickup_hour"] <= 5)).astype(
        float
    )
    df["is_weekend"] = df["pickup_day"].isin([5, 6]).astype(float)
    df["is_rush_hour"] = (
        ((df["pickup_hour"] >= 7) & (df["pickup_hour"] <= 9))
        | ((df["pickup_hour"] >= 16) & (df["pickup_hour"] <= 19))
    ).astype(float)

    # Manhattan distance approximation
    dlat_deg = np.abs(df["dropoff_latitude"].values - df["pickup_latitude"].values)
    dlon_deg = np.abs(df["dropoff_longitude"].values - df["pickup_longitude"].values)
    df["manhattan_est"] = dlat_deg + dlon_deg

    return df


def main():
    # Paths
    labels_path = "./input/labels.csv"
    test_path = "./input/test.csv"
    submission_dir = "./submission"
    os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # Load Data
    train_df, test_df = load_and_clean_data(labels_path, test_path)

    # Feature Engineering
    print("Engineering features...")
    train_df = engineer_features(train_df)
    test_df = engineer_features(test_df)

    # Features to use (important: passenger_count is now categorical via passenger_cat)
    feature_cols = [
        "pickup_hour",
        "pickup_day",
        "pickup_month",
        "pickup_year",
        "passenger_count",
        "passenger_cat",
        "distance",
        "distance_squared",
        "distance_cbrt",
        "pickup_latitude",
        "pickup_longitude",
        "dropoff_latitude",
        "dropoff_longitude",
        "is_night",
        "is_weekend",
        "is_rush_hour",
        "manhattan_est",
    ]

    # Shuffle and Split 80/20 for validation (keep this split for final evaluation)
    train_df = train_df.sample(frac=1, random_state=42).reset_index(drop=True)
    val_size = int(len(train_df) * 0.2)
    train_df_clean = train_df.iloc[:val_size]
    val_df = train_df.iloc[val_size:]

    # Define Target
    X_train = train_df_clean[feature_cols]
    y_train = train_df_clean["fare_amount"]
    X_val = val_df[feature_cols]
    y_val = val_df["fare_amount"]
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols]

    # Train LightGBM on training data only
    print("Training LightGBM model...")
    lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
    lgb_eval = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=lgb_train)

    params = {
        "objective": "regression",
        "metric": "rmse",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "feature_fraction": 0.9,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "verbose": -1,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "device": "cpu",
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    }

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        lgb_train,
        num_boost_round=200,
        valid_sets=[lgb_eval],
        valid_names=["valid"],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50, verbose=False)],
    )

    # Validate on hold-out set
    print("Evaluating on validation set...")
    y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    y_val_pred = np.nan_to_num(y_val_pred, nan=0.0)
    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_val_pred))
    print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

    # Generate submission predictions
    print("Generating submission predictions...")
    y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

    # Create Submission
    test_df["fare_amount"] = y_test_pred

    # Fill missing values with median fare
    median_fare = y_train.median()
    test_df["fare_amount"] = test_df["fare_amount"].fillna(median_fare)
    test_df["fare_amount"] = test_df["fare_amount"].clip(lower=0)

    # Format submission
    submission_df = test_df[["key", "fare_amount"]].copy()

    # Round to 2 decimal places
    submission_df["fare_amount"] = submission_df["fare_amount"].round(2)

    submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv"), index=False)
    print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
    print(f"Submission has {len(submission_df)} rows")
    print(f"Estimated validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
